text:
mira: Quick note  PR #487 merged a migration guide but CI shows snippet failures and a couple broken links.

mira: Broken link: /optkit/quant-profiles -> should be /optimize/quantization.

kevin: The Python example in the guide uses old API: QuantProfile(precision=..., calibrate=True). Needs updating to dtype + calibrator.

kevin: Replace with:
```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile, DefaultCalibrator
q = QuantProfile(dtype='qint8', calibrator=DefaultCalibrator())
```

tim: I'll open a small PR to update links and swap the snippet. I'll also grep for `kv_cache_enabled` and change to `kv_prefetch='auto'`.

jen: If it's just those changes, we can rerun CI and merge. Ping me when ready.

ci-bot: PR #487  snippet-exec: 1 failed, link-checker: 2 broken links. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/487/artifacts

mira: Also add a line in the migration checklist: "SDK <0.9 -> >=0.9: QuantProfile(precision=...) -> QuantProfile(dtype=...) and use calibrator API."

kevin: I'll add a tiny smoke test under docs/tests/snippets/quant_profile_smoke.py to catch this in future.

tim: PR in 25 minutes, tagging @kevin and @jen.

mira: Thanks team. Keeping release hold until CI green.
